description: Spot bitcoin ETF creation/redemption flows, computed as change in shares outstanding times NAV so price moves are removed and only genuine creations/redemptions remain. This series cannot be backfilled -- the issuer publishes only a current snapshot -- so every row was banked on the day it existed. span_days above 1 marks a row that spans a gap.

paid.description: true = request the pay-per-call (x402) quote or the live tier. Without a payment attached the call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object as an isError result; attach the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"] (or the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) and retry. Omit for the free, delayed tier.

name: etf_flows
